references.text: Whoever strikes a person so that they die shall be put to death. This is the foundational law on capital punishment for murder given in Exodus.
Whoever sheds human blood, by humans shall their blood be shed. This is the first biblical ordinance on punishment for murder, given to Noah after the flood.
Detailed laws concerning murder and capital punishment, which expand on the principle that whoever takes a human life must die.
The murderer shall be put to death, and no ransom may be accepted for the life of a murderer. This confirms that capital punishment is mandatory for murder.
Law regarding intentional murder and how the murderer is to be handed over to the avenger of blood to die.
Jesus says that all who take up the sword will perish by the sword. This reflects the principle of retribution for violence.
